description: Exit waterfall: how sale proceeds split between preferred series and common, with preference multiples, non-participating, participating or capped participation, and stacked or pari passu seniority. Each series converts to common when that pays more. Interactive version: https://raziel.co/tools/liquidation-preference-calculator

common_shares.description: Common shares outstanding, including exercised options (fully diluted common).

exit_value_usd.description: Net proceeds to equity holders at the exit.

seniority.description: "stacked": later series are paid first (listed last = most senior). "pari": all series share preferences pro rata.

participation.description: Non-participating, fully participating, or participating up to a cap.

participation_cap_multiple.description: Capped participation only: total payout cap as a multiple of the amount invested (3 = 3x).

name: liquidation_preference
title: Liquidation preference calculator
